title: Helpdesk weekly review
notes: Synthetic in-room meeting: You and Mark share the laptop mic (mic track); Dana is remote (system track). Same voices as meeting1, so names learned there should carry over.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Alright, Mark is here in the room with me today, and Dana is joining remotely. Let's go through the ticket numbers for the week.

lines.speaker: Mark
lines.text: We closed about forty tickets. Most of them were password resets and printer problems on the second floor.

lines.speaker: Dana
lines.text: The printer issue should be fixed now. I replaced the driver package on the print server yesterday afternoon.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Good. Did anyone call back about the laptop that would not join the wireless network?

lines.speaker: Mark
lines.text: Yes. Its certificate had expired. I renewed it and the laptop connected right away.

lines.speaker: Dana
lines.text: We should check the other laptops from that same order. They were all set up on the same day, so they might expire together.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Good catch. Dana, can you pull a list of certificates that expire in the next thirty days?

lines.speaker: Dana
lines.text: Sure, I will send that list on Monday.

lines.speaker: Mark
lines.text: I can renew whatever is on the list once Dana sends it over.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Great. One last thing. The new hire starts on Wednesday and still needs a laptop and an account.

lines.speaker: Mark
lines.text: The laptop is imaged and ready. I just need the account created before I hand it over.

lines.speaker: Dana
lines.text: I will create the account tomorrow and add it to the right groups.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Perfect. Thanks, both of you. That is everything for this week.
